text: This report reviews and recommends approval of an application to amend the Zoning By-law. The proposal is for three mixed use tower buildings, two of which share a podium, with tower at heights of 25, 37 and 42 storeys. 6,371 square metres of non-residential floor area is proposed, and 1,214 dwelling units. Of the proposed residential units, 447 units are proposed to be purpose built rental housing including 11 affordable rental units to be secured through Community Benefits Charge in-kind contribution, and 56 affordable rental units as a requirement of the Site and Area Specific Policy 796. The application also includes a vehicular and pedestrian access route to a Pick-Up and Drop-Off Loop (PUDO) that provides access to the Bloor GO/UP Express Station at 2376 Dundas Street West.
